public_rationale: This is the premise of Marcus's argument, not a factual report. If one operator controls thousands of fake personas, those personas are not independent voices by definition, so no study could show otherwise. The broader idea that democratic deliberation 'collapses' has no measure or threshold. The related empirical point, that fake swarms can make fringe views look like majority views, is assessed as a separate claim.
limitations: Someone could treat this as trivially true. It was graded not adjudicable because being true by definition is not the same as being empirically confirmed.
